description: REFINED thresholds with mutual exclusivity for big man archetypes. Added catch_shoot volume differentiators.
calibration_source: Week 1 Analysis: Differentiated P&R_ROLL_MAN from PUTBACK/POST_UP using catch_shoot volume

ISO_SCORER.description: Elite isolation scorer who creates own shots off the dribble

P&R_HANDLER.description: Pick & roll ball handler - primary creator who drives and dishes

P&R_ROLL_MAN.description: Pick & roll finisher - catches lobs/passes, decent catch_shoot volume

SPOT_UP.description: Catch & shoot specialist - high volume floor spacer
SPOT_UP.rule: 3 of 4: cs_fga > 4, cs% > 38%, cs_3pa > 3.5, cs > pull_up * 1.5

OFF_BALL_CUTTER.description: Pure cutter - scores at rim by cutting, minimal shooting

TRANSITION.description: Fast break threat - high motor player who runs the floor

PUTBACK.differentiator: VERY high rim, VERY low everything else

POST_UP.description: Back-to-basket scorer - slow, deliberate post player
POST_UP.differentiator: SLOW speed is the key identifier

mutual_exclusivity_logic.P&R_ROLL_MAN_vs_OFF_BALL_CUTTER: P&R_ROLL_MAN has catch_shoot >= 1.5 (pops), OFF_BALL_CUTTER has < 1.5 (cuts only)
mutual_exclusivity_logic.P&R_ROLL_MAN_vs_PUTBACK: P&R_ROLL_MAN has drives < 2.0, PUTBACK much stricter at < 0.8
mutual_exclusivity_logic.POST_UP_vs_others: POST_UP requires speed < 4.2, others don't have max speed requirement
mutual_exclusivity_logic.PUTBACK_vs_others: PUTBACK requires rim_freq > 0.55 and very low everything else

validation.v1_1_issue: Still 41% P&R_ROLL_MAN - bigs getting multiple tags
validation.v1_2_solution: Use catch_shoot volume to differentiate roll_man vs cutter, stricter PUTBACK
